phases.goal: Use the left arm to pull the microwave door open.
phases.name: pull_microwave_open
phases.verify: Door is visibly open and the microwave body remains in place.

semantic_recipe.relation_to_jsonl: Phases are transferable task guidance; the companion JSONL is the exact historical winning command sequence.

strategy_notes.coordinate_policy: Relocalize all objects, supports, contacts, and poses from current observations; do not reuse s0 coordinates.
critical_gates: Door angle opens without dragging the appliance.

task_language: Pull open the door of the yellow-sided microwave using the left arm.
vla_recipe: Exact sequence: 1:lingbot_act(chunks=3,use_length=50); 2:move_to(arm=left,gripper=open,orientation=keep). For every lingbot_act, use the original task_language exactly; relocalize every pose from current observations; do not replay clean coordinates.
